main_problem.instructions: Determine the single primary problem reported in the game review. STRICT RULE FOR PERFORMANCE VS BUGS: If the complaint is about low FPS, lag, stuttering, slow loading, or poor optimization, you MUST select performance_complaint (NOT bugs_complaint). Reserve bugs_complaint strictly for code errors, crashes to desktop, game freezes, or broken mechanics. Mentioning an aspect does NOT constitute a complaint; distinguish actual complaints from mere mentions or praise. If no clear complaint is made, select no_complaint.

criteria.performance_complaint: Complaints about low FPS, smoothness/fluidity, or slow loading times.
criteria.bugs_complaint: Describes a software bug or error, freezing, or an unexpected crash.
criteria.balance_complaint: Criticizes difficulty, controls, or game mechanics balance.
criteria.grind_complaint: Criticizes repetition or excessive effort required to progress.
criteria.multiplayer_complaint: Describes connection, matchmaking, or co-op/multiplayer problems.
criteria.monetization_complaint: Criticizes additional purchases, DLCs, loot boxes, or pay-to-win mechanics.
criteria.other_complaint: A clear complaint is present, but it does not fit the 6 specific categories above.
criteria.no_complaint: No clear complaint present; the review is positive, neutral, purely informational, or satirical.
